book.name: 2 TIMOTHY
book.title: TIMOTHY Laithak Ni Na Second Timothy

content: Tua ahikom, Ama hong kilang ciang in a kumpingam sungah mihing te le mithi te thu a khen tu Topa Jesus Christ le Pathian mai ah kong vaitha hi;
Pathian thuhil in; hunpha a om ciang ahizong, hunpha a om ngawl ciang ahizong, thinsau in hilna taw tek in a, tei in hanthawn in.
Banghangziam cile hilna mantak a ngai zawk ngawl uh hun hong theng tu hi; amate cilesa deina bang in thuhil te sia amate tungah ki khawmtuasak tu hi, amate bil te thak tu a;
Thuman pan in amate i bil te kihei siat tu hi, taciang phuatawm tangthu te nakheng daw in ngai zaw tu uh hi.
Ahihang nang na hile na theampo ah ngak in, haksatna te thuak in, thuphapuak nasep seam in, Pathian nasep sia khetnei ngawl in seam siat in.
Banghangziam cile keima sia tu in biakpiakna ah ki piak tu in ka kinging zo hi, taciang ka pusua tu hun hong nai zo hi.
Ki dona ah phatak in ka do zo hi, tai kidemna ah a tawpdong ka tai zo hi, upna zong ka keamcing zo hi:

Tu pan kipan in thutang suana kham lukhu sia keima atu in koi zo hi, tasia in a thutang thukhen pa Topa in tua ni ciang in hong pia tu hi: taciang keima bek hi ngawl in Ama hong kilang tu a ngakla te theampo zong pia tu hi.
A Khakbel Vaithakna
Ka kungah a manlang in pai tu in hanciam in:
Banghangziam cile Demas in hi leitung a it hu in hong nusia a, Thessalonica khua ah pai hi; Crescens sia Galatia ah pai a, Titus sia Dalmatia ah pai hi.
Ka kungah Luke bek om hi. Mark zong kawizawn in a, ka kungah hong paipui tan: banghangziam cile ama sia Pathian nasepna sungah keima atu in phatuam mama hi.
Taciang Tychicus sia Ephesus ah ka paisak zo hi.
Nongpai ciang in Troas a om Carpus kungah ka nusiat ka puantual tungsil sia hong keng kawm tan, taciang laibu te zong hong keng tan a, a tuan in savun laizial te hong keng tan.
Tau seak pa Alexander in ka tungah siatna tampi vawt hi: ama hong vawt nate bang in Topa in thukkik tahen:
Ama taw kisai nangma zong kidawm in; banghangziam cile ama in i thuhil nate nasiatak in hong do hi.
A masabel thu ka zo lai in kuama in hong panpui ngawl a, mi theampo in hong nusia siat hi: Pathian in amate mawsiat ngawl tu in thu ka ngen hi.

Ahihang Topa in hong panpui a, tha hong pia hi; tabang in ka thuhilna sia mihing theampo in a heak thei natu in le Gentile the theampo in a zak thei natu in humpi nealkai kam sung pan hong suaktasak hi.
Taciang Topa in nasep phangawl theampo sung pan in hong suaktasak tu hi, taciang Ama in vantung kumpingam hong thet dong hong suaktaksak tu hi; Ama tungah minthanna om tawntung tahen. Amen.
A Khakbel Vaithakna
Priscilla, Aquila le Onesiphorus innkuanpui te paupui in.
Erastus sia Corinth ah om a: ahihang Trophimus sia a cina ahikom in Miletus ah ka nusia hi.
Phalbi ma in ka kung pai tu in hanciam in. Eubulus, Pudens, Linas, Claudia le suapui theampo in hong paupui hi.
Topa Jesus Christ sia na thaa taw om tahen. Thuthiamna na tungah hong om tahen. Amen.
